Draft/Notes
Subject: Follow-up on delayed shipment — Order #[PO#] / Shipment #[ID]

Hi [Vendor Contact],

I’m following up on Order #[PO#] (Shipment #[ID]), which was due on [original ETA]. We haven’t received updated tracking or a revised ETA. Please confirm as soon as possible:

- Current shipment status
- Revised estimated delivery date and tracking number
- Cause of the delay and expected resolution timeframe
- Whether you can expedite or send a partial shipment

Please reply by [desired deadline, e.g., “end of day Monday”] and confirm when the shipment has been dispatched.

Thanks,
[Your name]
[Company]
[Phone / Email]

Notes/Next steps
- I can’t send emails, schedule sends, or send you an automated ping. If you’d like this sent Monday at 08:00 the vendor’s local time, I can:
  - Give step-by-step scheduling instructions for Gmail or Outlook, or
  - Insert the exact vendor email, PO/shipment numbers, and confirm the vendor time zone to produce a ready-to-schedule copy.
- To get notified once it’s sent: schedule the email in your client for Monday 08:00 and set a calendar reminder or task for that time to confirm dispatch (instructions available on request).
